scripts.build: g++ script.cpp status.cpp acknow.cpp viewport.cpp screenshot.cpp inputs.cpp utils.cpp actions.cpp character.cpp astar.cpp path.cpp licence.cpp converter.cpp main.cpp -o afk -std=c++17 -lX11 -lxdo -ljsoncpp -lpthread `pkg-config --cflags --libs opencv gtk+-2.0 appindicator-0.1` -Wno-deprecated-declarations && cp afk /opt/afk/
scripts.build2: g++ screenshot.cpp acknow.cpp viewport.cpp fredTest.cpp -o fred -std=c++17 -lX11 -lxdo -ljsoncpp -lpthread `pkg-config --cflags --libs opencv gtk+-2.0 appindicator-0.1`
scripts.prepare: sudo cp tibia.desktop afk.desktop /usr/share/applications/ && sudo apt install -y libx11-dev xdotool libxdo-dev xserver-xephyr openbox libjsoncpp-dev python3-pip libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libswscale-dev libgstreamer-plugins-base1.0-dev libgstreamer1.0-dev libgtk-3-dev libappindicator-dev libcanberra-gtk-module libvtk6-dev zlib1g-dev libjpeg-dev libwebp-dev libpng-dev libtiff5-dev libopenexr-dev libgdal-dev libdc1394-22-dev libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libswscale-dev libtheora-dev libvorbis-dev libxvidcore-dev libx264-dev yasm libopencore-amrnb-dev libopencore-amrwb-dev libgtk2.0-dev wget mpg123
scripts.push: git add . && git commit -m '-' && git pull && git push
